key_highlights: Australia enters its largest recorded housing downturn, threatening major bank loan books and mortgage asset quality.
The collapse of flagship retailer David Jones triggers acute supply chain distress and heightens shopping centre REIT vacancy risks.
Qantas flags a $1 billion fuel cost surge, necessitating airfare increases and flight capacity reductions.
Gold exploration and junior resources buck broader macroeconomic stagnation with strong capital raising and trading activity.
ASX benchmark (^AXJO) demonstrates defensive resilience, finishing the week higher despite persistent domestic growth headwinds.

sectors.trend: Severe credit compression and rising mortgage impairment risks
sectors.implications: Historic house price declines heighten loan-to-value ratio risks and dampen credit growth for CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX, and NAB.AX, while economic stagnation caps net interest margins.

sectors.trend: Acute insolvency and retail supplier balance sheet distress
sectors.implications: The failure of David Jones exposes unsecured suppliers to unpaid debt and signals severe discretionary consumer weakness as household wealth contracts.

sectors.trend: Structural vacancy threats for department-store anchored retail malls
sectors.implications: Retail landlords like SCG.AX and VCX.AX face leasing spreads contraction and costly re-anchoring capital expenditures following anchor department store failures.

sectors.trend: Severe operating margin pressure from elevated fuel costs
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces earnings downgrades as a $1 billion fuel cost hike forces fare rises and schedule cuts, testing consumer travel demand elasticity.

sectors.trend: Robust equity financing and speculative interest in gold and critical minerals
sectors.implications: Junior explorers and gold producers (BPM.AX, CHN.AX, AGC.AX, CRR.AX) benefit from strong liquidity and broker support despite broad macroeconomic softness.

sectors.trend: Execution momentum offset by local planning and development bottlenecks
sectors.implications: Community pushback against large-scale AI data centres highlights execution hurdles, even as operators like NXT.AX experience ongoing investor support.

key_themes: Historic housing market correction elevating banking sector systemic and credit risks
Department store collapse accelerating retail tenant rationalisation across major commercial REITs
Aviation and transport margins squeezed by escalating energy inputs
Resource juniors and gold equities serving as active liquidity havens amid broader GDP stagnation

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-valuation domestic retail banks; rotate exposure toward diversified offshore earners.
Limit exposure to regional retail mall REITs; favour logistics, prime industrial, or healthcare property assets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Aviation Jet Fuel Input Cost Shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Trim tactical holdings in domestic transport and aviation operators sensitive to fuel price spikes.
Position in defensive healthcare (CSL.AX) and non-cyclical consumer staples with stable pricing power.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold and Precious Metal Developers
opportunities.rationale: Strong broker support and heavy institutional capital raisings provide robust balance sheet buffers and upside leverage to gold prices.
High barriers to entry and structural AI compute demand insulate premier operators from domestic consumer cyclical downturns.
Insulated from domestic mortgage stress and sluggish GDP growth, backed by offshore revenue generation.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Major Mortgage Lenders
defensive_moves.rationale: Worst residential property downturn on record threatens loan book growth, increases credit provisioning, and compresses NIM.
David Jones collapse risks substantial anchor vacancy, tenant re-lease dilution, and downward retail asset revaluations.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Aviation and Discretionary Travel Holdings
defensive_moves.rationale: $1 billion fuel cost increase forces capacity cuts and ticket price hikes at a time when discretionary consumer budgets are severely stretched.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound and volatile (^AXJO: 8,100–8,350). Weak consumer discretionary spending and acute mortgage market strain will weigh on banks and retail REITs, partially cushioned by resource sector liquidity.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious recovery over 6–12 months. Deepening housing correction and stagnant GDP will likely pressure the RBA toward eventual monetary easing, paving the way for cyclicals to re-rate once real rates decline.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and interest rate trajectory
CoreLogic monthly national dwelling value and auction clearance data
Quarterly national GDP and retail sales figures
Global crude and jet fuel pricing developments
David Jones supplier debt recovery and administration developments
watch_list: RBA cash rate expectations and yield curve inversion
Major bank 90+ day mortgage arrears and impairment charges
AUD/USD exchange rate reactions to US and Australian macro divergences
Crude oil (Brent) and refinery margin spreads
Spot gold and iron ore export price benchmarks
